question: With the alpha1 reward long-term store (revision 10), does spaced re-teaching of a Stage 1 training board keep it correct after 10 further training boards are taught, and at which eta?
task: Predeclared fallback (journal 2026-10-25, before any v5 result): run only if retention probe v5 chooses no eta; fix-goal task 1 decision rule otherwise unchanged
override: Only learner.memory.eta changes (in memory, per probe; it sets both the restrained and the alpha1 rate); everything else is the revision-10 registration.
data: Training panels of the base registration only. Validation and final rows are never loaded.
aBoardRule: As probe v5: one A board per stratum, the first training panel by panelId whose unaided scratch choice is not the certified success (flagged fallback if a stratum is all correct).
lesson: As probe v5 (informative: verified task pulse plus Stockfish value pulse; PAM-alpha1 co-stimulated only with verified task-success pulses).
sequence: From scratch memory: lesson on A, 5 other boards, lesson on A, 5 other boards, lesson on A, 10 other boards; every other board is distinct and taught once; A is assessed after every lesson.
interferenceRule: The 23 other training panels ordered by sha256(seed:A:panelId); the first 20, in that order. The first 10 are probe v5's interfering boards in v5's order. The same boards and order are used for every eta.

decision.rule: Choose the largest eta whose A board is the unique top choice after the final 10 interfering lessons in at least 3 of 4 probes. A pass is reported as spaced-training retention, not one-shot retention. If none passes, stop and report.

measures: A certified-move rank and correctness after every lesson
A correctness right after each of its own lessons and at the end of each gap
each interfering board's rank before and after its lesson
pulse channels, currents, restrained and alpha1 factors and changed-edge counts
scope: Diagnostic spaced-repetition probe on training boards with one replica; not a gate result, not a learning claim and not biological validation. Lesson counts are not biological spacing intervals.
comparison: Matched to probe v5 (same registration revision 10, replica, scratch assessment, A-board rule, etas and lesson procedure). Differs only in the sequence: A is taught three times and 20 distinct boards interfere instead of 10. Action cues are cue v4 (revision 10), not revision 6.
